title: MĪZĀN: від коранічних принципів до перевірюваного управління мультиагентними системами
description: MIZAN: From Quranic Principles to Testable Multi-Agent Governance. Ukrainian working paper, author draft v0.1. The manuscript distinguishes normative motivation, proposed runtime controls, threat models and planned evaluations. It reports 24 local deterministic unit tests of a bounded mock model, not LLM experiments, production isolation or validated alignment. Independent peer review and a full Quranic source audit have not been completed.
notes: Working paper draft. The related MSAF identifier is not the DOI of this manuscript. AI assistance is disclosed in the manuscript.
